entities.name: Rayami, First of the Fallen
entities.description: A vampire bloodchief from Zendikar created by Ulamog, driven by bloodlust and Eldrazi madness.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan that created Zendikar's original vampires.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Mountainous region where the cultists lived near the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A godlike planeswalker who reinforced the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group that confronted the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: The only surviving bloodchief after the Eldrazi's defeat.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and their broods imprisoned on Zendikar.

events.summary: Cultists in Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison with their rituals and temple; broods spring into existence and devastate Zendikar.
events.quote: eventually loosened the bonds of the Eldrazi prison

events.summary: Twelve cultists survive and become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
events.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race

events.summary: Nahiri reinforces the Eldrazi prison and leaves, freeing the vampires of Ulamog's yoke.
events.quote: No more broods came to life after Nahiri reinforced the Eldrazi prison on her own.

events.summary: After the Eldrazi's defeat only Drana is said to survive among the bloodchiefs, so Rayami must be dead.
events.quote: Drana was said to be the only surviving bloodchief, so Rayami must now be dead.

relations.note: Like all original vampires of Zendikar.
relations.quote: he was created by the Eldrazi Ulamog
utterly enslaved to the will of Ulamog
